commits.messageBody:
Preinclude the balanced STLport deque and memory headers inside a Windows x64-only C4103 warning scope. Restore the warning afterward; no packing directive or public layout is changed.

VS2013 real crypto projects build in Release/Debug on Win32/x64. Four positive /WX probes pass; four intentional packing changes after the header are still rejected. Before/after layout probes match on all four configurations. Shared wrapper is mirrored first in the server fork; the legacy client algorithms are not copied over its newer Crypto++.

(cherry picked from commit 78e1f907c1fc0e386ffa75f7fdd0d915e66fe8e4)
commits.messageHeadline: crypto: scope x64 STLport packing warnings in the PCH

commits.messageBody:
Check size_t lengths before storing them in the legacy unsigned int length field. Keep the explicit unsigned-length constructor and representable input behavior unchanged.

Native VS2013 tests cover small transfers and synthetic boundary views which are never transferred. The original template constructor fails the oversized-length rejection oracle; the candidate rejects it. Win32 cannot represent an above-UINT_MAX size_t. This does not establish large-buffer processing support.

(cherry picked from commit 8fe43cca91e41503e3d47602c93058b76026f561)
commits.messageHeadline: crypto: reject StringStore lengths outside its unsigned range

commits.messageBody:
Make the unsigned message-count to bool conversion explicit, matching the existing unattached branch. Native fixtures cover empty and populated attached queues on Win32 and x64.

(cherry picked from commit 978a45d812961d80ce766be1676f5c6a88d61981)
commits.messageHeadline: crypto: test attached message counts explicitly for presence

commits.messageBody:
Reject a new completed message before its count would exceed UINT_MAX, preserving the one unfinished-entry invariant. The count accessor can then narrow explicitly.

Native tests exercise ordinary enqueue, retrieval and attached-queue behavior on both ABIs. The multi-billion-entry rejection boundary is source-reviewed, not runtime allocated or claimed as tested. Per-message byte-count limits are unchanged.

(cherry picked from commit 91dc05e8bebe0881d0540e74d4c53de909feb876)
commits.messageHeadline: crypto: keep MessageQueue counts within the public result width
